update_md5_fadee69b344b7f2dadcac9202e43b.semantics: A visible legacy Layer-1 summary must terminate its own synthetic turn and must not emit a synthetic resume that pressures reasoning. Detached sidecar capture is covered separately.

update_md5_3fbf0d56fcdb2eecdc47ab14ca2fe.name: assert_legacy_summary_terminal
update_md5_3fbf0d56fcdb2eecdc47ab14ca2fe.find_text:
const result = yield* prompt.loop({ sessionID: session.id }) expect(result.parts.some((part) => part.type === "text" && part.text === "resumed reasoning")).toBe(true)
const messages = yield* MessageV2.filterCompactedEffect(session.id) const summaryIndex = messages.findIndex((message) => message.info.role === "assistant" && message.info.summary) const resume = messages[summaryIndex + 1] const text = resume?.parts .filter((part): part is MessageV2.TextPart => part.type === "text") .map((part) => part.text) .join("\n") expect(text).toContain("protected reasoning/calibration flow") expect(text).not.toContain("Prefer tools and edits")
update_md5_3fbf0d56fcdb2eecdc47ab14ca2fe.semantics: Assert that legacy synthetic summaries terminate at the summary itself, never schedule a third provider call or append a resume turn, while retaining the protected reasoning wording inside the summary body.
